Dashboards built to be used, not just viewed

Each project below moved from raw data to a decision-ready view — click any screenshot to zoom in.

Academic Performance Dashboard

View Code ↗ Power BI

A two-page Power BI platform for a university's academic administration. Used Power Query to clean and merge course-grade exports, then built DAX measures for pass/fail percentage, average evaluation score and year-over-year trend. The Student Details page filters by exam type, academic year, student ID and department to drill into grade distribution and course status. The Faculty & Staff Details page ranks instructors by average student evaluation and compares pass/fail rates across departments and courses.

81.18% pass rate 170 students tracked 90% top instructor eval.
→ Pass rate dropped from Term 1 to Term 2 — flagged for department review.

Bank Loan Report Dashboard

View Code ↗ Excel

Built entirely in Excel with PivotTables and PivotCharts on a raw loan-applications export, plus calculated fields for DTI and interest-rate bands. The summary splits the portfolio into Good vs. Bad loans and breaks down funded vs. received amounts by DTI band, interest-rate band, and loan status (Fully Paid, Charged Off, Current) to show where credit risk concentrates.

38.6K applications 86.18% good loans 13.33% avg. DTI
→ 13.82% of loans are bad debt — isolated for closer credit-risk monitoring.

Sales Report Dashboard

View Code ↗ Power BI

A Power BI dashboard built on Q1 2019 point-of-sale data, with a day-level date slicer for drill-down. Tracks daily sales and gross-income trends over time, and breaks revenue down by city, branch, gender and product line to show where demand is concentrated across the three store locations.

322.97K total sales 3 cities · 3 branches 6 product lines
→ Food & beverages led every product line in gross income.

Customer Churn Analysis

View Code ↗ Power BI

Segments 7,043 customers into DAX-calculated churn-risk tiers (Critical / High / Medium / Low) based on tenure, contract type and payment method. Filterable by contract, internet service and tenure group, it quantifies revenue at stake per risk tier and tracks cohort churn rate across the customer lifecycle to flag where retention effort pays off most.

26.54% churn rate 2.86M revenue lost 7,043 customers
→ Month-to-month contracts drive 43% of churn — the clearest retention lever.

Supply Chain Dashboard

View Code ↗ Power BI

Consolidates supplier, cost and quality data across three product categories (Cosmetics, Haircare, Skincare), with DAX measures for defect rate, lead time and revenue by supplier. A cost-by-supplier-by-location matrix and a defect-by-inspection-result breakdown make it possible to compare all five suppliers on cost, speed and quality side by side.

$1.73M total cost 28.71 day avg. lead time 3% defect rate
→ 136 SKUs flagged high-defect — narrowed down to specific suppliers.

Healthcare Provider Dashboard

View Code ↗ Power BI

A multi-page view of a healthcare provider's billing and patient flow — costs by procedure and department, visit types, and year-over-year billing trends.

5,000 total visits £693.40 avg. billing 61% non-emergency
→ X-Ray procedures account for the largest share of total billing.

Data Professional Survey Breakdown

View Code ↗ Power BI

A Power BI analysis of a global data-professional survey, breaking down salary, language preferences, and career sentiment by job title, gender, and country to benchmark where the respondent base stands.

630 respondents 29.87 avg. age SQL most popular
→ 42.7% found breaking into data "Difficult" — salary satisfaction (4.27/10) trails work-life balance (5.74/10).
